source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the gonads and their hormones (PDF 67-68).

blocks.text: Gonads (auraton mein ovaries aur mardon mein testes) gametes (tolidi cells) banane wale organs hain. Yeh anterior pituitary ke LH aur FSH ke asar se sex hormones (jinsi hormones) bhi banate hain.
Ovaries zanana sex hormones, yani estrogen aur progesterone, chhorti hain:

items: Estrogen Graafian follicle (pakka hua follicle) FSH ke jawab mein chhorta hai. Is ke kaam: secondary sexual characteristics (sanvi jinsi khasusiyat) ki nashonuma, maslan chhatiyon ka barhna, pelvis (koolhe ki haddi) ka chaura hona, koolhon aur raanon par charbi ka phailao; menstrual cycle (haiz ka chakkar) ko qaboo karna; haiz ke baad uterus ki andaruni teh ki marammat; ovulation (ovary se anda nikalna); haddiyon ki mazbooti (bone density) qaim rakhna; "bura" cholesterol (LDL) kam karna; blood pressure sehatmand rakhna; mizaj aur yaaddasht ko qaboo karna.

Progesterone menstrual cycle ke dauran corpus luteum LH ke jawab mein banata hai. Hamal (pregnancy) mein placenta bhi ise banata aur chhorta hai. Yeh pituitary se mazeed FSH ka chhootna rokta hai, is liye mazeed follicles nahin pakte. Yeh hamal qaim rakhne ke liye uterus ki deewar ko mazeed mota aur khoon ki nalyon se bhar deta hai (vascularisation). Progesterone ovulation ko dabata hai.

blocks.title: For Information: puberty (balooghat)
blocks.text: Puberty nau-jawani ka woh daur hai jis mein sex organs pukhta hote hain aur secondary sex characteristics zahir hoti hain. Mardon mein sperm banna shuru hota hai, awaz bhaari hoti hai, seena chaura hota hai aur jism aur chehre par baal ugte hain. Auraton mein menstrual cycle shuru hota hai, chhatiyan barhti hain aur koolhe chaure hote hain.

blocks.title: For Information: doosre zariye
blocks.text:
Adrenal glands bhi thori miqdar mein estrogen aur testosterone chhorte hain.
Auraton mein bhi bohat thora testosterone banta hai.

LH testes ko sex hormones ka ek group chhorne par uksata hai jinhein androgens kehte hain. Testosterone ek androgen hai jo seminiferous tubules ke darmiyan maujood interstitial cells chhorte hain. Yeh mardana reproductive organs ki pukhtagi, secondary sex characteristics ke zahir hone aur sex drive (jinsi khwahish) ka aaghaz karta hai. Is ke ilawa normal sperm banne ke liye bhi testosterone zaroori hai.
Gonads ke hormones ka adam tawazun

items: Jawan larkiyon mein estrogen ki kami ho to woh jinsi taur par pukhta nahin hotin. Baligh auraton mein estrogen ki kami sterility (banjhpan) laati hai. Estrogen zyada ho to uterus mein fibroids (ghair maamooli barhao) aur polycystic ovaries ho sakti hain.
Menstrual cycle ke dauran progesterone kam ho to hamal ka imkan kam hota hai aur haiz jaldi aa sakta hai. Hamal ke dauran progesterone kam ho to miscarriage (isqaat-e-hamal) ho sakta hai.
Mardon mein testosterone kam ho to zanana khasusiyat paida hoti hain aur mardana sterility (banjhpan) hoti hai.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text:
Masnooi (artificial) steroids
Masnooi taur par banaye gaye steroids, jinhein anabolic steroids bhi kehte hain, khiladi khel mein karkardagi barhane ke liye kaafi istemal karte rahe hain. Yeh testosterone ki masnooi shaklein hain jo muscles, taqat aur bardasht barhate hain. Lekin khel mein anabolic steroids ka istemal ghair qanooni aur mamnoo (banned) hai, aur yeh lambe arse ke sehat ke masail la sakte hain:
• Jigar ko nuqsan, jis se hepatitis aur jigar ki rasoliyan (tumours) ho sakti hain.
• Dil ki bimari, stroke (falij) aur khoon ke lothron (blood clots) ka khatra barhta hai.
• Lamba istemal jism ka qudrati hormone tawazun bigaar deta hai: banjhpan (infertility), namardi (impotence) aur mardon mein chhatiyon ka barhna.
• Zehni masail bhi ho sakte hain, jaise udasi (depression), pareshani (anxiety) aur jarehana rawayya.

blocks.prompt: Menstrual cycle ke doosre hisse mein progesterone naye follicles ka pakna kyun rokta hai?
blocks.explanation: Progesterone pituitary se mazeed FSH ka chhootna rok deta hai, aur follicles ki nashonuma FSH hi karwata hai. FSH na ho to mazeed follicles nahin pakte.

items: Gonads gametes aur sex hormones banate hain, anterior pituitary ke LH aur FSH ke asar se.
Ovaries: estrogen (Graafian follicle, FSH) aur progesterone (corpus luteum, LH; hamal mein placenta). Testes: androgens, khaas taur par testosterone (interstitial cells, LH).
Adam tawazun: pukhtagi na hona, sterility, fibroids, miscarriage, mardon mein zanana khasusiyat. Anabolic steroids khel mein mamnoo aur nuqsandeh.
